messages:
kim: Short follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on comp/leveling. Posting bullets so folks can scan.
drew: Thanks! TL;DR?
kim: TL;DR: main comp cycle stays Nov; mid-cycle calibration in May; expedited promos allowed for retention/hire urgency (manager -> director -> people ops).
nora: How do we request expedited promos? form/link?
kim: We'll publish an "Expedited Promo" intake form and a 1-page guide. ETA: next Tue.
drew: Will expedited promos include off-cycle salary increases or equity refreshes?
kim: Salary increases yes if approved; equity generally reserved for planned refresh cycles unless Finance signs off for high-risk cases.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: benefits survey launches Mon 09:00 PT (please participate).
nora: Any material changes to parental leave or benefits this year?
kim: No material changes this fiscal year. We're collecting feedback via the survey.
drew: Will managers get examples for IC->Senior writeups?
kim: Yes, 3 sample narratives per transition will be added to the manager packet.
nora: Thanks! Appreciate the clarity.
kim: If you have a case, DM me or drop it here and tag @kim. Closing when docs live.
